_comment: Promo codes the lint allows in blog copy (W1.4). Only codes the airport, the lot, or Triply itself publishes AND that checkout accepts (an active promo_codes row). Every entry names its source. Anything else fails the write. TRIPLY10 was listed here on 2026-10-30 but no such row exists in promo_codes - add a code only after its row is created and active. Each entry: { code, source, addedOn, percentOff } or, for a flat-dollar code, { code, airport, source, addedOn, amountOff, minSubtotal, expiresAt }. percentOff is the ONLY savings claim the lint accepts for that code without an outside source. amountOff/minSubtotal are the only $ figures apply-edit's price check accepts for a flat code, and only in the block or field that names it, in a post for its airport, never as a per-day price. Each <IATA>5 code is one airport's code (bookings.promo_code shows which airport's posts drove the sale), so a post names its own airport's code; another airport's code is a warning. An entry past its expiresAt is ignored (checkout refuses it too). JFK5 and EWR5 (live since 2026-11-07) are held out: data/airports/JFK.json and EWR.json list both as Rightway Parking's 5%-off codes, so the name clash is decided before posts name them.
